messages:
marta: Morning — quick sync: I'm sketching a 'partner factory' capability map to standardize SI onboarding. Goal: map required technical checkpoints (api contract, auth, infra), training modules, and deliverables per SI tier. Who can help draft the tech checkpoint list?

devin: I can take the API/auth checkpoints. I'll add infra runbook items + acceptance tests. @kim can you add product contract bits? :thumbsup:

anas: happy to help — from SI side we need: end-to-end demo app, infra provisioning scripts, and a staging test harness. Also certification checklist must include rollback drills.

kim: adding product perspective: version pinning, model latency SLOs, telemetry hooks. Note: add "feature flags for gradual rollout" as a checkpoint.

cj: I'll make a master spreadsheet template and share. Quick columns: checkpoint, owner, evidence (artifact link), test steps, severity, SLA. uploading now → https://redwood.internal/drive/si-partner-factory-template.csv

partner-bot: New file uploaded by cj: /shared/si-partner-factory-template.csv (preview available)

marta: perfect. can we also align training modules to checkpoints? e.g., "auth & onboarding (30m)", "deploy & scaling (45m)", "observability & incident playbooks (30m)". Short live labs + checklist.

anas: labs are critical. Suggest we convert the E2E demo into a lab with a broken-nonfunctional step for troubleshooting assessment.

devin: i'll draft the API checklist this afternoon and post PR to the spreadsheet. small snippet for test harness command:

```\n./deploy-demo --env=staging --with-kms\npython tests/run_integration_tests.py --suite=si_smoke\n```

kim: on docs — let's not overload SIs. 3 core modules + 2 electives (marketplace listing, billing integration). Also add "privacy/compliance" elective for enterprise SI.

marta: Awesome. Plan: devin + kim + anas to produce initial capability map + training outline by EOD Wed. cj to publish template + make a workspace in Notion. We'll run a pilot cohort next month. :rocket:
